parameters.help_en: The ID of the job template
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The event ID. This parameter is user-defined and used for idempotence. Only one job is created for the same event ID
parameters.help_zh: 事件ID，用户自定义。用作幂等使用，相同事件ID仅创建一个任务
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The image startup command. The command must be an executable object that exists in the container. Example:

```
command:
      - echo
      - abc
      - >
      - file0
```
Based on the preceding example, Command="echo" and CommandArgs=["abc", ">", "file0"]
parameters.help_zh:
镜像启动命令。该命令必须为容器内存在的可执行的对象。示例如下：

```
command:
      - echo
      - abc
      - >
      - file0
```
根据上述示例，则`Command="echo", CommandArgs=["abc", ">", "file0"]`
parameters.name: command

parameters.help_en:
The arguments for the image startup command, which are required by the Command parameter. Format:

`["a","b"]`

In the preceding example, CommandArgs=["abc", ">", "file0"]. The `["abc", ">", "file0"]` part must be converted to a string in JSON array format. If this parameter is not required, you do not need to specify it
parameters.help_zh:
镜像启动命令参数。上述启动命令Command所需参数。格式如下：

`["a","b"]`

在上述示例中，`CommandArgs=["abc", ">", "file0"]`，其中`["abc", ">", "file0"]`需要转成String类型，里面的格式为JSON数组。如果无此参数，则无需填写
parameters.name: command_args

parameters.help_en:
The environment variables of the container. You can customize environment variables or reference configuration items. To reference a configuration item, you must first create a ConfigMap instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176914.html. Valid values:
Custom configuration
    - name: The name of the environment variable.
    - value: The value of the environment variable.
Reference a configuration item
    - name: The name of the environment variable. You can reference a single key or all keys. To reference all keys, enter `sae-sys-configmap-all-<configuration item name>`, such as `sae-sys-configmap-all-test1`.
    - valueFrom: The reference of the environment variable. Set the value to `configMapRef`.
    - configMapId: The ID of the configuration item.
    - key: The key. If you reference all key-value pairs, do not specify this field
parameters.help_zh:
容器环境变量参数。支持自定义或引用配置项。如需引用配置项，请先创建ConfigMap实例。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176914.html。取值说明如下：
自定义配置
    - name：环境变量名称。
    - value：环境变量值。
引用配置项
    - name：环境变量名称。支持引用单个或全部键，如果引用全部键，需输入`sae-sys-configmap-all-<配置项名称>`，例如`sae-sys-configmap-all-test1`。
    - valueFrom：环境变量引用。取值为`configMapRef`。
    - configMapId：配置项ID。
    - key：键。如果引用全部健值，则不设置该字段
parameters.name: envs

parameters.help_en:
The startup options for the JAR package job. The default startup command for the job is:
`$JAVA_HOME/bin/java $JarStartOptions -jar $CATALINA_OPTS "$package_path" $JarStartArg`
parameters.help_zh:
JAR包启动任务选项。任务默认启动命令：
`$JAVA_HOME/bin/java $JarStartOptions -jar $CATALINA_OPTS "$package_path" $JarStartArg`
parameters.name: jar_start_options

parameters.help_en:
The startup arguments for the JAR package job. The default startup command for the job is:
`$JAVA_HOME/bin/java $JarStartOptions -jar $CATALINA_OPTS "$package_path" $JarStartArgs`
parameters.help_zh:
JAR包启动任务参数。任务默认启动命令：
`$JAVA_HOME/bin/java $JarStartOptions -jar $CATALINA_OPTS "$package_path" $JarStartArgs`
parameters.name: jar_start_args

parameters.help_en: The startup command for the WAR package deployment job. The procedure is the same as configuring the startup command for image deployment. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96677.html
parameters.help_zh: 设置WAR包部署任务的启动命令，操作步骤与镜像部署的启动命令配置操作相同。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96677.html
parameters.name: war_start_options

parameters.help_en: The trigger time of the job. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en: The number of concurrent instances for the job
parameters.name: replicas
